aiVerification.summary: Draft identifies a valid normal versus frame+coil offset comparison but needs corrected factor, conditions, and outcome grouping.
issues: Changed factor is filename-based, not evidence-based.
Baseline and test conditions are left explicit as unknown.
Outcome metric is generic and mixes SPL, IMP, THD tables.
HZ/frequency axis is treated as a measured condition.
Change domain as lot is not supported by cited headers.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to frame+coil offset sample versus normal sample.
Set baseline to normal goods and test to frame+coil offset sample.
Keep SPL, impedance, and THD as separate outcomes under one factor.
Treat HZ as frequency axis, not a condition/result group.
Use header rows plus representative data rows for each table.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Cited rows support the comparison headers, but final evidence needs corrected row grouping and metric citations.
